entities.name: PMID:25093483
observations: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled 2-year trial in 61 older adults with mild cognitive impairment, followed by a 2-year single-blind extension.
Renal function was assessed with abbreviated MDRD and CKD-EPI equations; over 4 years, longitudinal changes were not significant for aMDRD (P=.453) or CKD-EPI (P=.213).
The abstract reports no specific adverse renal event signal and concludes chronic low-dose lithium did not affect renal function, while noting nonrenal adverse events and design limitations.
The abstract does not report lithium dose, achieved serum concentrations, arm-specific retention, serum creatinine values, confidence intervals, or urinary concentrating ability.
